description: This file contains a Spring configuration class for setting up messaging components using ActiveMQ in a Fineract project, including connection factory and JMS listener configuration.

classes.name: MessagingConfiguration
classes.description: Spring configuration class that sets up JMS messaging components such as ConnectionFactory and JmsListenerContainerFactory for ActiveMQ.

methods.name: activeMQConnectionFactory
methods.description: Creates and configures the ActiveMQ ConnectionFactory, setting broker URL and credentials if provided.

methods.name: jmsListenerContainerFactory
methods.description: Creates and configures the DefaultJmsListenerContainerFactory for JMS listeners, with a custom destination resolver.

methods.name: isBrokerPasswordProtected
methods.description: Checks if the broker username or password is non-empty to determine if broker access is password protected.
